name: provider
description: Model provider identifier (google, anthropic, openai, self_hosted).

name: model
description: Canonical model identifier governed by this rule.

name: environment
description: Scoped deployment environment (prod, staging, eval, or '*').

name: risk_tier
description: Scoped risk tier (RL-1 through RL-5) or '*' wildcard.

name: is_allowed
description: TRUE when invocations matching this scope are permitted.

name: invokable_status
description: Operational routing status (active, drain, or circuit_broken).

name: zdr_allowed
description: TRUE when the endpoint satisfies Zero Data Retention for regulated judging and inference.

name: lifecycle_tier
description: Release stability track (long_term_ga, short_term_ga, or preview).

name: eol_date
description: Published model end-of-life or deprecation cutoff date.

name: deprecation_notice_days
description: Contractual deprecation notice window in days.

name: migration_target_model
description: Recommended successor model identifier for lifecycle migration.

name: min_cache_tokens
description: Minimum prefix-cache token floor required for cached pricing.

name: effective_from
description: SCD-2 inclusive UTC start timestamp for this governance rule.

name: effective_to
description: SCD-2 exclusive UTC end timestamp (NULL while active).
